message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts.

Facts: A company and its legal representative used a recommendation letter in the name of the government office to allow a company without oil extraction qualification to actually engage in oil extraction. They intended to share illegal profits. They paid 200,000 RMB to a public official (Zhang) as improper remuneration (bribe). So this is bribery (unit bribery? Actually they are paying a public official, so they are the bribers. The unit (company) and its legal representative are giving bribe to a public official. That is "单位行贿" (unit bribery) or "对单位行贿"? The list includes "单位行贿" and "对单位行贿". Let's see definitions: "单位行贿" is when a unit (organization) gives bribe to a state functionary. "对单位行贿" is when a person gives bribe to a unit? Actually "对单位行贿" means bribing a unit (i.e., a public institution). In this case they bribed a public official (Zhang). So it's unit bribery (the unit is the bribing party). So label: "单位行贿". Also possibly "滥用职权" for the official, but the defendant is the company and its legal representative. The charge is unit bribery. Also maybe "介绍贿赂"? That is introducing bribe? Not here. So answer: [罪名]单位行贿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: They used a recommendation letter to allow illegal oil extraction. That could be "滥用职权" for the official, but not for the company. Could be "非法经营" but not in list. Could be "非法占用农用地"? No. Could be "非法采伐"? No. So only unit bribery.

Thus final answer: "单位行贿".
